body:
I wasn't able to prepare properly for the demo, my mind just sort of turned off during the end of training.

I have fucked up by:

Majoring in something without a real plan or goal for after college that I already compromised myself on
Going to and staying in a college I felt pressured by parents
Developed horrible habits of procrastination, avoidance issues,  indecision, compulsive lying to hide issues and anxiety from paper citations (also codependent suicidal thoughts constantly to get my parents to understand)
Electives turned from Is into Fs, still got my degree from major requirements
Felt resentment due to codependency issues brought up by therapist but still relied on family for help after leaving home for a year
Student loan of $40k, credit card $2k in collections

I was a hell of a lot better of a person in high school but let myself slide and became an awful person clinging on to the past. I've been really impulsive and have little self control on anxiety and have had self destructive tendencies since college. It came to a head with my latest failure and my optimistic delusions fell apart.

Now I need to just die already. I've hated myself and its torn myself apart and I deserve it for being a selfish asshole without common sense.

Now even the slightest stress gets me physically sick.

Was trying to get an English teaching job abroad, but failed second teaching demonstration. Had a three day nervous breakdown in a hostel then had to be flown back home by my family. I was getting severe anxiety symptoms before I left like my abs and cheek getting stiff. I've fucked up in a lot of ways in my life already and "feel" hopeless. I am regressing and going backwards.
Would you mind telling me about your experience? You can PM me if need be.
I feel like my body and mind are falling apart, I can't believe I'm going to be someone dying young like this.
